title: OpenAgentix approval result, v1alpha1
description: The members a tool of a system of record returns in the JSON object of its result when it asks for an approval, reads one, or changes a record in a way that cancels one (ADR 0028). A tool may return more members. The platform reads only these. Text written by people stays outside these members or under names that start with untrusted_. The convention carries no payload text and no amount.

approval.description: Present in the result of a tool that creates or reads one request. Absent otherwise.

allOf.description: A request that waits has no decider yet.
A request that a person approved or rejected names who decided it. superseded and expired are not decisions of a person.

status.description: Only pending waits for a person. expired is for a record that expires requests; the reference records service does not.

subject.description: The record the act is about.

payload_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the exact payload text the approver reads, as 64 lower-case hex characters. A match shows only that the approver's client fetched the same text, not that a person read it.

proposed_by.description: An opaque id from the record's own authentication. The platform never treats it as a verified person.

decided_by.description: An opaque id from the record's own authentication. Empty until a decision.

trace_id.description: The W3C trace id (32 lower-case hex) of the call that proposed the act, or unknown when the record did not receive one. A lookup hint, not evidence: the caller of the gate chooses it.

superseded_approvals.description: Present in the result of a write that superseded one or more pending requests: their ids. An agent that sees it must not report those requests as pending.
